title: Sequencing: inspection visits
bodyMd:
An inspector visits five sites in order during one day. Each site is visited exactly once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Bridge, Court, Dock, Hall, Tower.

- Bridge must occur after Court and before Hall.
- Tower must not be in position 5.
- Dock and Hall must not occupy consecutive positions.
